# V2EX DSH Client
Read-only V2EX browsing and intelligent discovery for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). The plugin offers an a
uthenticated sidebar and the same bounded capabilities through Agent Tools. 中文说明
## Requirements

- Node.js 22 or newer
- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`
- A V2EX Personal Access Token (PAT)
## Install from npm
Install the published package into the DSH profile you use, then restart DSH when prompted:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `<name>` with your DSH profile name. Verify that the package is installed:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
After DSH restarts, open the V2EX item in the sidebar and sign in with a V2EX Personal Access Token.
The package is also available on npm.
## Install from a local checkout
For development, install dependencies and build the package first:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Use an absolute path to the checkout. The Host entry is `v2ex-dsh-client`, the browser entry is `v2e
x-dsh-client/client`, and the included `dsh.plugin.json` and `cordis.patch.yml` contain bundle metad
h-client/client`, and the included `dsh.plugin.json` and `cordis.patch.yml` contain bundle metadata.
## Sign in
Create a PAT in V2EX account settings, open the V2EX sidebar in DSH, and paste it into the form. The
Host validates it before saving it in the DSH credential service. It is never put in plugin setting
s, content storage, browser storage, model prompts, Agent Tool results, or logs. Token replacement v
alidates the new credential before switching accounts. Logout can optionally remove local profile an
d recommendation data.
## Read-only guarantee
Every request this plugin sends to V2EX uses `GET` and is restricted to official V2EX HTTPS origins.
It reads token status, member identity, latest/hot/node topics, the public section tabs (`/?tab=tec
h`, `/?tab=jobs`, ...), the public node catalog, topic details, and replies. It cannot create or cha
nge topics or replies, thank, favorite, ignore, block, boost, delete, or otherwise mutate V2EX data.
The sidebar uses same-origin Host routes to change local settings and state. Those local `POST`, `PU
T`, and `DELETE` operations never become V2EX writes. All model-facing tools are read-only.
## Browsing and AI
Latest, Hot, section tabs (Tech, Creative, Play, Apple, Jobs, Deals, City, Q&A;, Hot, All, R2, VXNA)
, and Nodes support topic and paginated reply reading. Section tabs link into the nodes that appear
in them, and the Nodes view lists the common node catalog so any node can be opened directly. Conten
t is validated, size-limited, cached, and marked when stale. AI summaries are explicit actions and d
isclose topic and reply-page coverage. Without AI services, normal browsing still works.
V2EX text is untrusted input. Only bounded normalized data goes to the current DSH model, model tool
s are disabled, and structured output is validated. AI output can be incomplete or wrong; the source
discussion remains authoritative.
## Interest learning and privacy
History learning is off by default and starts only after explicit authorization in Interest. The plu
gin selects bounded user-authored plain text while excluding system, assistant, tool, attachment, cr
edential-shaped, and internal metadata content. Raw history is not stored; only an editable structur
ed profile is persisted.
Users can inspect and edit labels, preferred nodes, and exclusions; pause automatic learning; manual
ly relearn; revoke authorization; or clear the profile. Revocation prevents future history reads. In
terests, settings, recommendations, read state, and feedback are isolated by verified V2EX account.
## Refresh, rate limits, and reminders
Background refresh runs only while the DSH Host is running. Defaults are every 30 minutes, the lates
t feed, and up to two pages of preferred nodes. Local filtering precedes bounded AI ranking. Interac
tive reads have priority; background work pauses near V2EX's reported rate limit.
Settings control refresh interval, followed nodes, per-source pages, AI candidate budget, notificati
on threshold, and quiet hours with an IANA timezone. Quiet hours suppress delivery but may still ref
resh recommendations.
Reminders go only to a suitable active top-level DSH Agent. They may remain pending if no Agent is a
vailable or it is busy, and are retried while the Host is active. They are not operating-system noti
fications and are not guaranteed after DSH exits.
## Configuration
Normal operation has no token setting or environment variable. Authentication uses only the sidebar
and DSH credential service. Runtime options are in Settings and Interest. `V2EX_TEST_TOKEN` is reser
ved for the optional maintainer smoke verifier; runtime and the deterministic release gate never use
for the optional maintainer smoke verifier; runtime and the deterministic release gate never use it.
## Troubleshooting
- **Sign-in rejected:** create a new PAT, check its expiration, and paste it without surrounding whi

tespace.
- **Offline or stale:** the last validated cache is shown because V2EX is unreachable. Retr

y when connectivity returns.
- **Rate limited:** wait for the reported reset; background work reserv

es capacity for interactive reads.
- **AI unavailable:** configure a current DSH model. Browsing rem

ains available.
- **History learning unavailable:** install the DSH history-query service, then expl

icitly authorize learning.
- **No reminder:** check quiet hours, threshold, unread items, and whethe

r an active top-level Agent can accept delivery.
- **Wrong account data:** log out with personal-dat
a clearing, then sign in to the intended account.
Public errors use stable codes together with bounded static messages and retryability metadata. They
never include raw upstream or model-provider diagnostics.
